time_base: All '*_trimmed' times (and the per-wave summary) are seconds from the trimmed start; add trim_offset_s for times in moonlight_iii.wav.

first_note.note: File is digital silence to ~2.0 s, then < -60 dBFS low-level noise until the first attack (LH C# on bar 1 beat 1; the RH arpeggio's first note follows one 16th later). Trim offset = attack - 10 ms pre-roll, so the first note sits at 0.010 s on the trimmed timeline.

tempo.tempo_note: Use the chord-spacing figures. librosa's beat tracker locks onto a sub-beat level here (the 16th-note arpeggios), so its number is not the quarter-note tempo. Waves 1-3 are two bars long (about 3.2-3.3 s); waves 4-5 are one bar long (about 1.6 s). Bars 9-14 (G# pedal, fermata) separate wave 5 from wave 6.

cut_in_candidates.event: bar 198 beat 1 (sf E6, top of the final arpeggio; starts the one-gesture descending cascade)
bar 199 beat 1 (downbeat inside the descending cascade; 5th-finger group start on C#5, no accent)

proposal.cut_in_event: bar 199 beat 1 (cut-in placed 10 ms before its attack)
proposal.mid_run_check: Bars 197-199 are continuous 16th-note arpeggios; bars 198-199 form one descending cascade from the sf E6 (bar 198 beat 1) to the low C# (bar 200 beat 1). Every cut-in that yields 5.6-6.4 s therefore lands inside that run. Bar 199 beat 1 is the best compromise: a bar downbeat and a group start, but not accented. The accented bar-198 sf gives 7.08 s (to -50 dBFS) or 7.89 s (to -50 dB re peak) instead.
proposal.end_rule: final chord decayed 50 dB below its own peak (-64.6 dBFS)

opening.note: Starts at the trim offset, so its timeline equals the '*_trimmed' times in this file. Length is 20.000 s as requested (the filename says 18s). Contains waves 1-5; wave 6 (from 25.05 s trimmed) is outside it. 2 ms fade-in (signal there is below -60 dBFS, 10 ms before the first note) and 10 ms fade-out declicks.

ending.note: Cut-in at bar 199 beat 1 minus 10 ms; 10 ms linear declick fade-in only (no musical fade). 10 ms declick fade-out at the end, where the signal is already about -65 dBFS.

splice_candidates.method: Score (Mutopia MIDI, reference only) aligned to the recording with open-end chroma DTW (checked against measured wave chords: errors of 5-30 ms, one 111 ms outlier); each predicted event snapped to the strongest measured onset within +/-150 ms and refined (median of flux, high-band rise and bias-corrected librosa onset).

primary.why: Closest downbeat to 54 s. Starting ending.wav 0.013 s early puts its bar-199 attack exactly on the bar-32 downbeat, so the meter carries through the splice. The bar-32 downbeat is a trill start, not an accent; the sf of that bar falls on beat 2 (54.784).
